A '''Jedi pilot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. He was sent to test drive the [[Vanguard (Defender-class light corvette)|Vanguard]] developed by [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|Rendili Vehicle Corporation]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], but he was knocked unconscious and left outside by [[Hylo Visz]] when she stole the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].
